business_summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited provides power products and solutions for power generation, transmission, distribution, and automation sectors in India and internationally. It offers metal enclosed capacitor banks; reactors, including series, shunt, FACTS/HVDC, and iron core reactors; transformers comprising special purpose, earthing, converter duty, dry type, and arc furnace transformers; PLCC components that include wave traps and LMU/LMDU; instrument transformers, such as current, potential, and discharge coil/PT's transformers; and Edison composites, as well as switchgears and circuit breakers. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is based in Sangli, India.
